messages:
Morgan (compliance): Auditor asked for chain-of-custody for an RBAC change on 2024-11-15. They want KMS usage logs + RoleBinding diffs + proof of approval. Can we assemble a minimal bundle? CC @Alex @Nina @Samir :eyes:
Alex (sec-eng): We have RBAC audit events in /prod/security/rbac-audit/*. They include change event IDs, who performed the change, and context. Approvals are in approvals-service events (svc=approvals-api). Recommend we include a signed manifest (sha256) for the bundle.
Nina (infra): I can export CloudTrail entries for KMS key usage + envelope decrypt ops and the API calls that touched rolebindings. Need the exact time window. I will redact key material; we only ship metadata + event records :lock:.
Morgan (compliance): Time window = 2024-11-15 02:00 to 2024-11-15 05:00 UTC (approx). Also need the PR link + merge commit associated with the RBAC change and a pre/post RoleBinding diff.
Samir (SRE): I can stitch a 'changeproof' timeline linking events by event_id. Example extraction command I run locally:

```
python tools/make_changeproof.py \
  --start "2024-11-15T02:00:00Z" \
  --end "2024-11-15T05:00:00Z" \
  --include rbac_audit cloudtrail approvals-api \
  --map-ids --output s3://redwood-evidence/changeproof/1714501234/
```

Samir (SRE): The script outputs: manifest.json (with sha256), timeline.csv (event_id,event_time,service,actor,ref), and a mapping file linking KMS CloudTrail event ids to RBAC event ids.
Alex (sec-eng): Also include the KMS key identifier path (ARN) in the manifest but redact the last 6 chars in the artifact we hand to the auditor (we can show full internally). e.g. `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd...XXXXXX`
IncidentBot: Runbook checklist created: [evidence_hash], roleback_plan.md, approver_emails.csv, logs.tar.gz, mapping.csv. Please ensure manifest signed by sec-eng lead.
Auditor Jen: Can you provide 1) sha256 of the final bundle, 2) CSV mapping KMS event -> RBAC event ids, 3) proof of approval (approval-service record or email), and 4) a redacted triage note if change was in response to a vuln?
Morgan (compliance): Yes  plan: Nina exports CloudTrail (CSV) and KMS events, Samir runs make_changeproof and produces mapping.csv + timeline.csv, Alex generates signed manifest and signs the hash, I will upload to a presigned s3 link and share here with sha256. Redaction notes will be included in manifest.
Nina (infra): Started export job: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2024-11-15T02:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-15T05:00:00Z` -> writing to s3://evidence-temp/1714501234-snapshot.gz. ETA ~2h :hourglass:
Alex (sec-eng): Also attach the retention policy pointer (retention-doc v2.1) showing logs retention config and legal hold if applicable. I'll attach link in bundle.
Auditor Jen: Good. Also please include a one-line statement confirming that no key material was re-imported or rotated during the window, and if rotation occurred, provide the rotation event id.
Samir (SRE): We have triage notes on ticket INC-2109 (2024-11-14). Will include a redacted summary (no PII) and a link to the internal triage doc (redacted).
Morgan (compliance): Manifest fields we will include: bundle_hash, files_included (list), redaction_notes, contact, retention_refs, approver_list. I will create the presigned link once all artifacts are in s3 and post sha256 here. :thumbsup:
Alex (sec-eng): One more ask: include a short README.txt explaining how to verify the manifest and hash (example `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256`).
Auditor Jen: Thanks  please post presigned s3 URL + sha256 here when ready. We will verify mapping and manifest and follow up with any clarifying Qs.
Morgan (compliance): Noted. I'll ping when upload done.
Nina (infra): Upload started to s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/1714501234/changeproof.tar.gz (temp ACL=private). Will switch to presigned link when ready.
Alex (sec-eng): Quick reminder: mark the bundle with evidence classification and create an access log entry for auditor downloads (we'll capture IP and timestamp).
Morgan (compliance): Will do. Estimated delivery <= EOD today.
Auditor Jen: Appreciated. If anything changes, flag here.
Samir (SRE): Will attach mapping.csv + timeline.csv once script finishes.
Morgan (compliance): Closing loop after upload. Thanks team.
